L093.assumptions: Closed four-store carbon initial air40/plants30/detritus20/fuel10, total100. Sequential transfers photosynthesis air→plants8, plant respiration plants→air3, litter plants→detritus4, decomposer-respiration branch detritus→air2, optional combustion fuel→air5. Original units per step, not Earth rates. Omit living microbial/animal/ocean/rock stores and external exchange; decomposition has other omitted fates. Energy is not cycled.
L093.limits: Plant carbon mainly does not come from soil; carbon cycling is not energy cycling, and decomposition includes respiration and other omitted storage pathways.
L093.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L093.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L094.assumptions: One marked N atom, including one of two atoms within N2, not molecule counts. Uptake route N2→NH4→NO2→NO3→organicN→NH4; return route branches NO3→N2. Microbial fixation/nitrification/denitrification and ammonification represented. Most plants acquire NH4/NO3, including direct NH4 route omitted in animation. Chemical reaction partners and gas intermediates omitted; forms only, no kinetic prediction.
L094.limits: Relevant microbes perform fixation; plants can absorb ammonium without prior nitrification, and denitrification differs in direction from nitrification.
L094.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L094.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L095.assumptions: Production-energy budget in kJ per equal area/time. Input1000, transfer efficiencies0.05/0.1/0.2; detritus0.3*input; heat=input-next-detritus. Repeat across three levels. Fixed detritus share illustrative, not empirical universal. Decomposers receive multiple-level detritus and also respire; no energy return to Sun. Pyramid widths schematic, production numbers quantitative.
L095.limits: Ten percent is not universal; decomposers connect multiple levels, and matter cycling does not imply energy recycling.
L095.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L095.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.

L096.assumptions: Original litter-decomposition rate index baseline100 with fixed litter input and equal disturbance intensity. Standardized brief drought/flood pulse lasts through day1 measurement, then common baseline moisture is restored and maintained until day30. Day0,1,30 snapshots. Moisture effects on enzymes/survival and compensation by survivors with differing tolerances are stipulated. Communities diverse4/redundant4/single1; drought trajectories100,70,90 /100,40,65 /100,65,88; flood100,55,85 /100,75,92 /100,20,45. Resistance=day1/100; 30-day recovered-loss fraction=(day30-day1)/(100-day1), not universal resilience rate. No replication, confidence interval or species forecast.
L096.limits: More species do not automatically stabilize every function under every disturbance; recovery measures need a function, baseline and time window.
L096.data: Original representative hypothetical values; no measurements or forecast.
L096.license: Original project model and records; no external dataset copied.
